sources.query:
-- ACTUAL: current, non-soft-deleted state of the target dimension (the SCD2 row Informatica currently considers authoritative). ROW_WID, EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT/TO_DT, CURRENT_FLG, DELETE_FLG, W_INSERT_DT/W_UPDATE_DT and ETL_PROC_WID are intentionally excluded from this comparison: they are produced by EXP_SCD2_DATES / a sequence generator / SESSSTARTTIME / the prior existing target row (via Lkp_W_BANK_D's self-referencing lookup), i.e. they depend on ETL run history and session state, not on the current staging row's business data, so they cannot be independently recomputed by a stateless query.
SELECT
  INTEGRATION_ID, DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  BANK_KEY_CODE, BANK_NAME,
  BANK_TYPE_CODE, BANK_TYPE_NAME,
  BANK_CAT_CODE, BANK_CAT_NAME,
  COUNTRY_CODE, COUNTRY_NAME,
  STATE_CODE, STATE_NAME,
  SWIFT_CODE, SWIFT_NAME,
  BANK_HIER_CODE, BANK_HIER_NAME,
  BANK_BRANCH_CODE, BANK_BRANCH_NAME,
  CREATED_BY_WID, CHANGED_BY_WID,
  PHONE_NUM, TAX_NUMBER, CONTACT_NAME, BANK_USER_NAME,
  BANK_ID, ACCDET_ID, ACCDET_NAME,
  BANK_ACCT_NUM, BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, BANK_ALT_NUM, BANK_ALT_NAME,
  COUNTRY_REGION, STATE_REGION, POSTAL_CODE, COUNTY,
  STREET_ADDRESS1, STREET_ADDRESS2, CITY,
  BANK_NUMBER, ACTIVE_FLG,
  SET_ID, TENANT_ID, X_CUSTOM, BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, PRIMARY_FLAG,
  CREATED_ON_DT, CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX2_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX3_CHANGED_ON_DT, AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, SRC_EFF_TO_DT, END_DATE
FROM POC.W_BANK_D
WHERE CURRENT_FLG = 'Y' AND DELETE_FLG = 'N'

-- EXPECTED: independently derived from the staging table plus the W_CODE_D code-name lookups and the W_USER_D user-WID lookup, reproducing Exp_W_BANK_D_Transform's nested-IIF fallback logic (LKP value -> source code/name -> $$SOURCE_CODE_NOT_SUPPLIED / $$MASTER_CODE_NOT_FOUND) as CASE/COALESCE. This is NOT copied from any mapping-level SQL override -- the mapping's own source qualifier and target-comparison lookup have no such override to copy from; this query re-implements the Informatica expression logic from scratch.
-- ASSUMPTIONS (correct before trusting results):
--   1. $$LANGUAGE_CODE mapping parameter default is 'E' (hardcoded below as W_CODE_D.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E'); substitute the actual deployed parameter-file value if different.
--   2. $$SOURCE_CODE_NOT_SUPPLIED / $$MASTER_CODE_NOT_FOUND mapping parameter defaults are '<Source Code Not Supplied>' / '<Master Code Not Found>'; substitute actual deployed values if different.
--   3. All 7 code lookups use 'Lookup policy on multiple match' = Use Last Value against W_CODE_D; approximated here with a plain LEFT JOIN (assumes SOURCE_CODE+DATASOURCE_NUM_ID+CATEGORY+LANGUAGE_CODE is effectively unique in W_CODE_D). LKP_W_USER_D's 'Use Last Value' on a date-range match is approximated with MAX(ROW_WID) among matching rows.
--   4. W_BANK_DS is assumed to hold one current-batch row per (DATASOURCE_NUM_ID, INTEGRATION_ID), matching the target's current (CURRENT_FLG='Y') row -- i.e. the SCD2 history-comparison machinery in Lkp_W_BANK_D / Exp_W_BANK_D_Update_Flg / EXP_SCD2_DATES is out of scope for this comparison (see JDBC 1 note).
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    S.INTEGRATION_ID, S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
    S.BANK_KEY_CODE, S.BANK_NAME, S.BANK_TYPE_CODE, S.BANK_TYPE_NAME, S.BANK_CAT_CODE, S.BANK_CAT_NAME,
    S.COUNTRY_CODE, S.COUNTRY_NAME, S.STATE_CODE, S.STATE_NAME, S.SWIFT_CODE, S.SWIFT_NAME,
    S.BANK_HIER_CODE, S.BANK_HIER_NAME, S.BANK_BRANCH_CODE, S.BANK_BRANCH_NAME,
    S.CREATED_BY_ID, S.CHANGED_BY_ID, S.CREATED_ON_DT, S.CHANGED_ON_DT,
    S.AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT, S.AUX2_CHANGED_ON_DT, S.AUX3_CHANGED_ON_DT, S.AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT,
    S.SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, S.SRC_EFF_TO_DT, S.END_DATE,
    S.PHONE_NUM, S.TAX_NUMBER, S.CONTACT_NAME, S.BANK_USER_NAME,
    S.BANK_ID, S.ACCDET_ID, S.ACCDET_NAME, S.BANK_ACCT_NUM, S.BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, S.BANK_ALT_NUM, S.BANK_ALT_NAME,
    S.COUNTRY_REGION, S.STATE_REGION, S.POSTAL_CODE, S.COUNTY, S.STREET_ADDRESS1, S.STREET_ADDRESS2, S.CITY,
    S.BANK_NUMBER, S.ACTIVE_FLG, S.SET_ID, S.TENANT_ID, S.X_CUSTOM, S.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, S.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, S.PRIMARY_FLAG,
    CB.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_BANK_CODE, CB.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_BANK_NAME,
    BT.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_BANK_TYPE_CODE, BT.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_BANK_TYPE_NAME,
    BC.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_BANK_CAT_CODE, BC.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_BANK_CAT_NAME,
    CT.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_COUNTRY_CODE, CT.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_COUNTRY_NAME,
    ST.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_STATE_CODE, ST.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_STATE_NAME,
    SW.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_SWIFT_CODE, SW.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_SWIFT_NAME,
    BH.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_BANK_HIER_CODE, BH.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_BANK_HIER_NAME,
    BB.MASTER_CODE AS LKP_BANK_BRANCH_CODE, BB.MASTER_VALUE AS LKP_BANK_BRANCH_NAME
  FROM POC.W_BANK_DS S
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D CB ON CB.CATEGORY = 'BANK' AND CB.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND CB.SOURCE_CODE = S.BANK_KEY_CODE AND CB.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D BT ON BT.CATEGORY = 'BANK_TYPE' AND BT.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND BT.SOURCE_CODE = S.BANK_TYPE_CODE AND BT.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D BC ON BC.CATEGORY = 'BANK_CAT' AND BC.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND BC.SOURCE_CODE = S.BANK_CAT_CODE AND BC.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D CT ON CT.CATEGORY = 'COUNTRY' AND CT.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND CT.SOURCE_CODE = S.COUNTRY_CODE AND CT.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D ST ON ST.CATEGORY = 'STATE' AND ST.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND ST.SOURCE_CODE = S.STATE_CODE AND ST.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D SW ON SW.CATEGORY = 'SWIFT' AND SW.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND SW.SOURCE_CODE = S.SWIFT_CODE AND SW.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D BH ON BH.CATEGORY = 'BANK' AND BH.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND BH.SOURCE_CODE = S.BANK_HIER_CODE AND BH.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
  LEFT JOIN POC.W_CODE_D BB ON BB.CATEGORY = 'BANK_BRANCH' AND BB.LANGUAGE_CODE = 'E' AND BB.SOURCE_CODE = S.BANK_BRANCH_CODE AND BB.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = S.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID
)
SELECT
  B.INTEGRATION_ID, B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_BANK_CODE, B.BANK_KEY_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS BANK_KEY_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_BANK_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_BANK_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_BANK_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.BANK_KEY_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.BANK_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS BANK_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_BANK_TYPE_CODE, B.BANK_TYPE_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS BANK_TYPE_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_BANK_TYPE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_BANK_TYPE_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_BANK_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.BANK_TYPE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.BANK_TYPE_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS BANK_TYPE_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_BANK_CAT_CODE, B.BANK_CAT_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS BANK_CAT_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_BANK_CAT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_BANK_CAT_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_BANK_CAT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.BANK_CAT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.BANK_CAT_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS BANK_CAT_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_COUNTRY_CODE, B.COUNTRY_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS COUNTRY_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_COUNTRY_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_COUNTRY_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_COUNTRY_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.COUNTRY_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.COUNTRY_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS COUNTRY_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_STATE_CODE, B.STATE_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS STATE_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_STATE_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_STATE_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_STATE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.STATE_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.STATE_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS STATE_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_SWIFT_CODE, B.SWIFT_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS SWIFT_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_SWIFT_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_SWIFT_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_SWIFT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.SWIFT_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.SWIFT_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS SWIFT_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_BANK_HIER_CODE, B.BANK_HIER_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS BANK_HIER_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_BANK_HIER_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_BANK_HIER_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_BANK_HIER_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.BANK_HIER_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.BANK_HIER_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS BANK_HIER_NAME,
  COALESCE(B.LKP_BANK_BRANCH_CODE, B.BANK_BRANCH_CODE, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') AS BANK_BRANCH_CODE,
  CASE WHEN B.LKP_BANK_BRANCH_NAME IS NOT NULL THEN B.LKP_BANK_BRANCH_NAME
       WHEN B.LKP_BANK_BRANCH_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN NULL
       WHEN B.BANK_BRANCH_CODE IS NOT NULL THEN '<Master Code Not Found>'
       ELSE COALESCE(B.BANK_BRANCH_NAME, '<Source Code Not Supplied>') END AS BANK_BRANCH_NAME,
  (SELECT MAX(U.ROW_WID) FROM POC.W_USER_D U WHERE U.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U.INTEGRATION_ID = B.CREATED_BY_ID AND U.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT <= B.CREATED_ON_DT AND U.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT >= B.CREATED_ON_DT) AS CREATED_BY_WID,
  (SELECT MAX(U.ROW_WID) FROM POC.W_USER_D U WHERE U.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID = B.DATASOURCE_NUM_ID AND U.INTEGRATION_ID = B.CHANGED_BY_ID AND U.EFFECTIVE_FROM_DT <= B.CHANGED_ON_DT AND U.EFFECTIVE_TO_DT >= B.CHANGED_ON_DT) AS CHANGED_BY_WID,
  B.PHONE_NUM, B.TAX_NUMBER, B.CONTACT_NAME, B.BANK_USER_NAME,
  B.BANK_ID, B.ACCDET_ID, B.ACCDET_NAME, B.BANK_ACCT_NUM, B.BANK_ACCT_ALT_NUM, B.BANK_ALT_NUM, B.BANK_ALT_NAME,
  B.COUNTRY_REGION, B.STATE_REGION, B.POSTAL_CODE, B.COUNTY, B.STREET_ADDRESS1, B.STREET_ADDRESS2, B.CITY,
  B.BANK_NUMBER, B.ACTIVE_FLG, B.SET_ID, B.TENANT_ID, B.X_CUSTOM, B.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME, B.AGENCY_LOCATION_CODE, B.PRIMARY_FLAG,
  B.CREATED_ON_DT, B.CHANGED_ON_DT, B.AUX1_CHANGED_ON_DT, B.AUX2_CHANGED_ON_DT, B.AUX3_CHANGED_ON_DT, B.AUX4_CHANGED_ON_DT,
  B.SRC_EFF_FROM_DT, B.SRC_EFF_TO_DT, B.END_DATE
FROM base B
